image_description: A close-up side view of a butterfly perched on a textured gray surface (likely stone or concrete). The butterfly has orange-brown wings with visible eyespots (ocelli) featuring blue and red centers. The body is slender, brown, and appears hairy. Two long, clubbed antennae are clearly visible extending forward. Legs are thin and jointed, gripping the surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct antennae are visible with clear thickening at the tips (clubs), matching the diagnostic feature.
